decisions.reason: As the current generation of a core voltage-measurement module in an established line, it remains strategically central and would usually stay unless a successor or component issue forces a change.

The MQTT proxy is a low-cost software complement that broadens the platform's connectivity options, so the firm would typically keep this option open unless usage proves persistently too small to justify maintenance.

The CO2 sensor module serves a meaningful sensing niche within the platform and still offers enough application value to retain, even though hardware sourcing and niche demand make it less secure than core modules.

The touch panel accessory is comparatively peripheral and more exposed to weak uptake, but as a still-useful add-on for prototyping and interface projects it is more likely to be monitored further than dropped immediately.
